population.exposure_methodology: Direct OSM building footprint occupancy (4.6 persons/building)

definitions.population_exposure: Number of individuals whose physical residences or work places intersect the flood inundation zone.
definitions.population_at_risk: Exposed individuals subject to life-threatening hydrodynamic conditions (depth > 1.2m, velocity > 2 m/s).
definitions.casualties: Requires empirical evacuation warning time and building collapse dynamics; strictly NOT inferred here.

population.disclaimer: Population exposure estimates individuals located inside the flooded footprint for emergency evacuation planning. It strictly does NOT infer or predict casualties or fatalities.
